title: Account Management
description: Manage information system accounts, group memberships, and authorization tokens.
remediationGuidance: Establish automated account management and disable inactive administrative sessions.
provenance: Official NIST SP 800-53 Revision 5 public catalog

title: Access Enforcement
description: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources.
remediationGuidance: Configure role-based administrative access and strict management interface ACLs.
provenance: Official NIST SP 800-53 Revision 5 public catalog

title: System Use Notification
description: Display an approved system use notification message or banner before granting access to the system.
remediationGuidance: Configure login banner motd or system login message with authorized usage statements.
provenance: Official NIST SP 800-53 Revision 5 public catalog

title: Remote Access Management
description: Authorize and monitor remote access connections using cryptographic mechanisms and secure protocols.
remediationGuidance: Enforce SSH v2 with cryptographic key exchange and terminate unencrypted remote channels like Telnet.
provenance: Official NIST SP 800-53 Revision 5 public catalog

title: Event Logging
description: Identify system events that the system is capable of logging in support of the audit function.
remediationGuidance: Enable audit logging for configuration changes, administrative sessions, and access failures.
provenance: Official NIST SP 800-53 Revision 5 public catalog

title: Time Stamps
description: Use internal system clocks to generate time stamps for audit records synchronized with authoritative time sources.
remediationGuidance: Configure Network Time Protocol (NTP) with authenticated synchronization to trusted servers.
provenance: Official NIST SP 800-53 Revision 5 public catalog

title: Audit Record Generation
description: Audit system activities and forward audit records to an independent centralized logging repository.
remediationGuidance: Configure logging host forwarding using syslog to a dedicated centralized SIEM collector.
provenance: Official NIST SP 800-53 Revision 5 public catalog

title: Configuration Settings
description: Establish and document configuration settings for IT components using security configuration checklists.
remediationGuidance: Apply validated vendor hardening profiles across all managed network devices.
provenance: Official NIST SP 800-53 Revision 5 public catalog

title: Least Functionality
description: Configure systems to provide only essential capabilities and prohibit or restrict unneeded ports and protocols.
remediationGuidance: Disable unencrypted management protocols including Telnet, HTTP, and SNMPv1.
provenance: Official NIST SP 800-53 Revision 5 public catalog

title: Identification and Authentication
description: Uniquely identify and authenticate organizational users and processes before system access.
remediationGuidance: Enable centralized AAA (RADIUS or TACACS+) and eliminate shared or default credentials.
provenance: Official NIST SP 800-53 Revision 5 public catalog

title: Authenticator Management
description: Manage system authenticators including passwords, keys, and certificates with minimum complexity standards.
remediationGuidance: Enforce password minimum length of 14 characters and strong password hashing.
provenance: Official NIST SP 800-53 Revision 5 public catalog

title: Boundary Protection
description: Monitor and control communications at external boundaries and key internal boundaries.
remediationGuidance: Enforce firewall access control policies and restrict management services to trusted subnets.
provenance: Official NIST SP 800-53 Revision 5 public catalog

title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
description: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information using cryptography.
remediationGuidance: Enforce TLS/HTTPS for web management and SSHv2 for terminal access.
provenance: Official NIST SP 800-53 Revision 5 public catalog

title: Cryptographic Protection
description: Implement cryptographic modules in accordance with applicable federal laws and FIPS standards.
remediationGuidance: Utilize FIPS-approved ciphers and disable legacy broken cryptography.
provenance: Official NIST SP 800-53 Revision 5 public catalog

title: Enforce SSHv2 Remote Management
description: The network device must use SSHv2 to protect the confidentiality and integrity of remote CLI sessions.
remediationGuidance: Configure 'ip ssh version 2' and disable unencrypted terminal protocols.
sourceReference: DISA Network Device Management SRG NET-0400 / V-220527
provenance: DISA DoD Cyber Exchange public machine-readable SRG

title: Disable Telnet Protocol
description: The network device must not operate unencrypted remote access services including Telnet.
remediationGuidance: Disable Telnet on all VTY and AUX lines.
sourceReference: DISA Network Device Management SRG NET-0410 / V-220528
provenance: DISA DoD Cyber Exchange public machine-readable SRG

title: Disable Unencrypted HTTP Management
description: The network device must disable unencrypted HTTP web server administration.
remediationGuidance: Configure 'no ip http server' and enforce HTTPS with TLS 1.2+.
sourceReference: DISA Network Device Management SRG NET-0420 / V-220529
provenance: DISA DoD Cyber Exchange public machine-readable SRG

title: Enforce Centralized AAA Authentication
description: The network device must authenticate administrative users via a centralized AAA server (TACACS+ or RADIUS).
remediationGuidance: Enable AAA new-model and point default login groups to corporate TACACS+/RADIUS clusters.
sourceReference: DISA Network Device Management SRG NET-0500 / V-220530
provenance: DISA DoD Cyber Exchange public machine-readable SRG

title: Forward Syslog to Central Collector
description: The network device must forward audit log events to a central logging facility.
remediationGuidance: Specify remote logging host IP with informational logging trap.
sourceReference: DISA Network Device Management SRG NET-0600 / V-220531
provenance: DISA DoD Cyber Exchange public machine-readable SRG

title: Disable SNMPv1 Unencrypted Access
description: The network device must not use SNMPv1 or unencrypted read-write community strings.
remediationGuidance: Disable SNMPv1/v2c communities and migrate to SNMPv3 with authPriv encryption.
sourceReference: DISA Network Device Management SRG NET-0700 / V-220532
provenance: DISA DoD Cyber Exchange public machine-readable SRG

title: Synchronize Time with Authoritative NTP
description: The network device must synchronize internal system clocks using authenticated NTP.
remediationGuidance: Configure redundant authenticated NTP servers.
sourceReference: DISA Network Device Management SRG NET-0800 / V-220533
provenance: DISA DoD Cyber Exchange public machine-readable SRG

title: Display DoD Advisory Warning Banner
description: The network device must display the approved standard DoD logon advisory banner prior to logon.
remediationGuidance: Configure 'banner motd' with authorized usage warning text.
sourceReference: DISA Network Device Management SRG NET-0900 / V-220534
provenance: DISA DoD Cyber Exchange public machine-readable SRG

title: Ensure SSH Version 2 is enabled
description: Disables unencrypted remote administration protocols and mandates SSH version 2.
remediationGuidance: Configure 'transport input ssh' and 'ip ssh version 2'.
sourceReference: CIS Cisco IOS XE 17.x Benchmark v2.2.1 Section 1.1.1
provenance: Derived from CIS Benchmark Section 1.1.1 hardening recommendations

title: Ensure Telnet service is disabled
description: Prohibits plaintext remote access across network interfaces to protect credentials.
remediationGuidance: Disable telnet under line vty and line aux.
sourceReference: CIS Cisco IOS XE 17.x Benchmark v2.2.1 Section 1.1.2
provenance: Derived from CIS Benchmark Section 1.1.2 hardening recommendations

title: Ensure HTTP server is disabled
description: Disables unencrypted web server administration across management ports.
remediationGuidance: Configure 'no ip http server' and 'ip http secure-server'.
sourceReference: CIS Cisco IOS XE 17.x Benchmark v2.2.1 Section 1.1.3
provenance: Derived from CIS Benchmark Section 1.1.3 hardening recommendations

title: Ensure AAA subsystem is active
description: Enables centralized AAA access control for user authentication and authorization.
remediationGuidance: Configure 'aaa new-model' in global configuration.
sourceReference: CIS Cisco IOS XE 17.x Benchmark v2.2.1 Section 1.1.4
provenance: Derived from CIS Benchmark Section 1.1.4 hardening recommendations

title: Ensure remote syslog logging is configured
description: Ensures security-relevant audit records are sent to a dedicated remote syslog host.
remediationGuidance: Configure 'logging host <ip-address>'.
sourceReference: CIS Cisco IOS XE 17.x Benchmark v2.2.1 Section 1.1.5
provenance: Derived from CIS Benchmark Section 1.1.5 hardening recommendations

title: Ensure SNMPv1/v2c are disabled
description: Prohibits unencrypted community strings and weak legacy SNMP versions.
remediationGuidance: Remove legacy public/private community strings and implement SNMPv3.
sourceReference: CIS Cisco IOS XE 17.x Benchmark v2.2.1 Section 1.1.6
provenance: Derived from CIS Benchmark Section 1.1.6 hardening recommendations

title: Ensure NTP is configured
description: Synchronizes system time with reliable NTP time servers for audit integrity.
remediationGuidance: Configure 'ntp server <ip-address>'.
sourceReference: CIS Cisco IOS XE 17.x Benchmark v2.2.1 Section 1.1.7
provenance: Derived from CIS Benchmark Section 1.1.7 hardening recommendations

title: Ensure warning banner is configured
description: Presents a legally binding warning banner before interactive logon.
remediationGuidance: Configure 'banner motd ^Authorized Access Only^'.
sourceReference: CIS Cisco IOS XE 17.x Benchmark v2.2.1 Section 1.1.8
provenance: Derived from CIS Benchmark Section 1.1.8 hardening recommendations

title: Access control
description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and implemented.
remediationGuidance: Enforce strict user authentication and access authorization across network infrastructure.
provenance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A standard reference control metadata

title: Logging
description: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected and analysed.
remediationGuidance: Forward audit and security logs to centralized logging infrastructure.
provenance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A standard reference control metadata

title: Network security
description: Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.
remediationGuidance: Harden network management interfaces and mandate encrypted administrative access.
provenance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A standard reference control metadata

title: Use of cryptography
description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented.
remediationGuidance: Enforce strong ciphers and disable unencrypted management channels.
provenance: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A standard reference control metadata
